midjourney.role: Text-to-image generator with style tools, editing and short video.
midjourney.audience: Designers, illustrators and creators who want aesthetic images and will pay for a subscription.
pros: Unlimited Relax mode from Standard: Standard and up give unlimited image generation in Relax mode, plus 15 to 60 fast GPU hours a month by plan.
Version 8 in active development: V8.1 brought a fast HD mode 3x cheaper per the announcement; an editing model V8.2 was added in September 2026 on the experimental site.
Style tools and moodboards: per the V8.1 announcement, moodboards and style references (sref) are more stable; image prompts and image weights returned.
cons: No free plan on the pricing page: four paid plans only, from 10 USD/month, no free trial mentioned.
Private generations only on Pro and up: Stealth mode, which hides creations, is only in Pro and Mega.
V8 only on the experimental site: V8 models are only on alpha.midjourney.com in early testing and may change without notice.
midjourney.price: From 10 USD/month billed monthly, or 8 USD/month billed annually. No free plan on the pricing page.
plans: Fast GPU time not stated; extra Fast hours can be bought.
15 fast GPU hours/month, unlimited Relax image generation.
30 fast GPU hours/month, unlimited Relax for images and SD video, Stealth mode.
60 fast GPU hours/month, unlimited Relax for images and SD video, Stealth mode.
midjourney.privacy: Not verified. Per the pricing page only Pro and Mega include Stealth mode, so on other plans creations are visible.
midjourney.rights: The pricing page lists 'General commercial terms' on all four plans; details (ownership, large-company terms) not read.
midjourney.watch: Users report billing that continued after cancelling.

magnific.role: Platform for creating and editing images, video and audio with many models, plus image upscalers and a stock library.
magnific.audience: Creators and designers who want many models, upscalers and stock in one subscription.
magnific.status: Renamed: Freepik AI is now Magnific, official site magnific.com. The page does not address the freepik.com stock site.
pros: Many models and upscalers in one subscription: all plans include image, video and audio models, image and video upscalers, Brand Kit and 250M+ stock assets. Plus adds Magnific and Topaz upscalers.
Unlimited generation from Plus: 'UNLIMITED generations' in Nano Banana 2 at 1K and selected other models.
Connections to other tools: all plans include MCP and plugins, ComfyUI and API billed by credits. Freepik API keys keep working.
cons: Credits are per year, not per month: shown as an annual quota (240K on Premium) valid for a year, no monthly reset.
No free plan on the pricing page: three paid plans only, from 20 USD/month.
Prices exclude VAT and local taxes.
magnific.price: From 20 USD/month billed monthly or 14.50 USD/month billed annually (Premium, 240K credits a year), before VAT. No free plan shown.
plans: 240K credits/year, image, video and audio models, Magnific One and Brand Kit, commercial AI license, image and video upscalers, MCP and plugins, ComfyUI, API by credits.
600K credits/year, unlimited generation in Nano Banana 2 at 1K and selected models, commercial AI license incl. music rights, Magnific and Topaz upscalers.
Everything in Plus; page shows 1.5M and 4M credits/year, Nano Banana 2 at 2K and Nano Banana Pro.
magnific.rights: All plans list a 'Commercial AI license'; Plus and Pro add music rights. License terms not read, and a commercial license doesn't protect against copyright claims.
magnific.api: Yes. All plans include API access billed by credits. Freepik API keys keep working. API price list not checked.
magnific.hebrew: Not mentioned in source (only text-to-speech 'in multiple languages').

photoroom.role: Product photo editor: background removal, AI-generated backgrounds and virtual models, on mobile and web.
photoroom.audience: Online sellers, product photographers and designers who need to remove backgrounds and produce product images fast.
pros: Low price on annual billing: Pro is 7.50 USD/month billed annually with 8,000 AI credits and 1,000 exports a month.
On mobile and browser: iPhone, iPad and Android apps, a web app and a Shopify app.
Separate background-removal API: the API has its own plans, Basic for background removal and Plus for image editing.
cons: Monthly price not shown: the pricing page shows annual prices only.
4K and video only on pricey plans: ad video starts at Max, 4K images only at Ultra; export limit applies to images up to 2K.
Plans don't include API: Pro, Max and Ultra have no API quota; API is sold separately.
photoroom.price: From 7.50 USD/month billed annually (Pro). Monthly prices and free-plan details not shown.
photoroom.trial: Pro and Max offer 'Start free trial'; length not stated.
plans: 8,000 AI credits and 1,000 exports/month, editing tools, AI Backgrounds, AI Fashion Models.
25,000 AI credits and 3,000 exports/month, video for ads and product pages (up to 50 generations), Shopify connection.
75,000 AI credits and 10,000 exports/month, up to 150 video generations, 4K images and HD video.
photoroom.rights: Not verified: pricing page doesn't address commercial use.
photoroom.api: Yes. Separate API plans: Basic (Remove Background API), Plus (Image Editing API) and Enterprise. Prices not shown.

adobe-firefly.role: Studio for creating and editing images and video with Adobe and partner models, integrated in Creative Cloud apps.
adobe-firefly.audience: Designers and students working in Adobe tools who want outputs for commercial use.
pros: Adobe models presented as commercially safe: per Adobe, its models were trained on licensed Adobe Stock content and public-domain material, and outputs may be used commercially.
Partner models in one place: GPT Image, Gemini (Nano Banana) and FLUX alongside Firefly models; Topaz Labs image-enhancement models were added at MAX 2026.
Connects to Adobe apps: send outputs to Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere, Lightroom and Adobe Express. Firefly Image Model 5 outputs native 4MP.
cons: Free plan is limited and undefined: a limited number of daily generations and limited model access, no explicit credit number.
Partner models without commercial assurance: per Adobe, the user must check whether content from a partner model suits the project.
Pro and Pro Plus prices include a temporary promotion: the first 6 months are discounted 50% to 60%; the regular price is then 19.99 or 49.99 USD/month.
adobe-firefly.price: Free plan with limited daily generations. Paid from 9.99 USD/month (Standard, 2,000 credits). Pro and Pro Plus prices temporarily discounted.
adobe-firefly.free: Firefly Free: limited daily image and video generations, limited access to Adobe and partner models, image and video editors and Firefly Boards.
plans: Limited daily image and video generations, limited model access, image and video editors and Firefly Boards, 1 generation at a time.
2,000 generation credits/month, up to about 400 images or 20 five-second videos, 2 at a time.
4,000 credits/month, about 800 images or 40 five-second videos, 4 at a time.
10,000 credits/month, about 2,000 images or 100 five-second videos, 6 at a time.
adobe-firefly.privacy: Per the product page, 'Firefly models never train on what you create or upload', and Adobe doesn't train Firefly or partner models on Creative Cloud subscribers' personal content. Full privacy policy not checked.
adobe-firefly.rights: Per Adobe, Firefly model outputs are allowed for commercial use. For partner-model content the user must check suitability. This is not a full guarantee against claims.
adobe-firefly.hebrew: Not mentioned in source: Firefly accepts prompts 'in multiple languages' and translation in 'over 20 languages', languages not listed.
adobe-firefly.students: No separate Firefly student price: the Students & Teachers tab shows the same prices. The page points to a general Creative Cloud discount: 'Students & Teachers Save 77% on Creative Cloud'.
adobe-firefly.watch: Users report paid credits are spent even when a generation fails, and that quality dropped since the latest updates.

flux.role: Family of models for creating and editing images and video, available via API, as open weights and inside other tools.
flux.audience: Developers, studios and advanced creators who integrate an image model into their own tools or workflows.
pros: Pay per image, no subscription: per the price list there are no subscriptions or seat fees; you pay for what is generated. FLUX 3 Image Klein is from 0.008 USD per image.
Text in several languages inside images: per the announcement, FLUX 3 can 'render high-accuracy text in multiple languages' and also generates video with audio.
Available inside other tools: FLUX models are partner models in Adobe Firefly.
cons: No official consumer subscription on the price list: it is for API and licenses. A direct no-code interface was not verified.
No known free credits: the price list mentions none for new users.
Some licenses only via sales: Professional, Enterprise and Synthetic Data weight licenses need sales contact; others show no price.
flux.price: Pay-per-use API, no subscription: from 0.008 USD per image (FLUX 3 Image Klein) up to 0.607 USD per 4K image on FLUX 3 Image.
plans: 0.03 USD for the first megapixel, 0.015 per extra megapixel and reference image.
0.07 USD for the first megapixel, 0.03 per extra megapixel and reference image.
0.014 USD for the first megapixel, 0.001 per extra megapixel.
Image editing by prompt, 0.04 USD per image.
Open-weight licenses: Builder, Platform, Professional, Enterprise, Synthetic Data; price not shown.
flux.rights: Not verified for API outputs. Open weights have separate commercial licenses (Builder, Platform, Professional, Enterprise, Synthetic Data) per the price list.
flux.api: Yes. Paid by megapixel or per image, e.g. FLUX.2 [pro] at 0.03 USD for the first megapixel and FLUX 3 Image at 0.048 USD per 1K image. Open-weight models such as FLUX.2 [klein] are also licensed.
flux.hebrew: Not mentioned in source (FLUX 3 shows text 'in multiple languages', languages not listed).

ideogram.role: Text-to-image generator especially suited to images that include written text.
ideogram.audience: Designers and students who need images with text, logos or typography.
pros: Free weekly credits: eligible free accounts get slow generation credits each week at no charge.
Commercial use on all plans: per the pricing page, Ideogram doesn't claim ownership of the images and you may use them for any purpose, including commercial.
Large quota on Pro: Pro includes 3,500 priority credits a month and private generation.
cons: Free credits aren't guaranteed: weekly credits go only to eligible accounts signed up with Google, Apple or Microsoft, and the amount may change.
No discounts or free trial: per the page, Ideogram offers no discounts or trial for subscription plans.
Private generation only when paid: unpublished images are available to Plus and Pro subscribers.
ideogram.price: Free plan with weekly credits for eligible accounts. Plus is 15 USD/month, Pro is 504 USD/year.
ideogram.free: Weekly slow-generation credits for eligible free accounts signed up with Google, Apple or Microsoft. Amount not stated and may change.
plans: Weekly slow-generation credits for eligible accounts.
1,000 priority credits/month, unpublished image generation (per the FAQ).
ideogram.privacy: Not verified. Per the pricing page, unpublished generation is only for Plus and Pro subscribers.
ideogram.rights: Per the pricing page: "We do not claim ownership of your generated images, and you're free to use them for any purpose, including commercial use." This is no protection against claims.
ideogram.api: Yes. The pricing page describes API rates and volume discounts billed separately for Enterprise; the rates themselves weren't shown.
ideogram.students: No student discount. Pricing page: "We don't offer discounts or free trials for subscription plans".

leonardo-ai.role: Platform for creating images and video with many models, with a daily free plan.
leonardo-ai.audience: Creators and students who want to try many models free, up to professional team use.
pros: Free credits renew every day: the free plan includes 150 Fast Tokens a day, with no time limit.
Pay-per-use API: start with a 5 USD credit, no commitment, and the credit doesn't expire.
Commercial use even when free: per the pricing page, even the free plan grants a non-exclusive commercial-use license to your creations.
cons: On the free plan images are public: all Free images are public and Leonardo.Ai may use, copy, modify and distribute them.
Private creations start at Apprentice: hiding creations is available from Apprentice, 12 USD/month billed monthly.
leonardo-ai.price: Free plan with 150 credits a day. Paid from 12 USD/month (Apprentice), or about 10 USD/month billed annually.
leonardo-ai.free: Free with no time limit: 150 Fast Tokens a day. All images are public and Leonardo.Ai keeps the right to use them. A non-exclusive commercial-use license is granted.
leonardo-ai.privacy: Not verified: privacy policy not read. Per the pricing page, on the free plan all images are public and Leonardo.Ai may use, copy, modify and distribute them.
leonardo-ai.rights: Per the pricing page, even the free plan grants a 'non-exclusive, royalty-free licence' for commercial use of creations, and Leonardo.Ai keeps rights to use them.
leonardo-ai.api: Yes. Pay-per-use API starting with a 5 USD credit, no commitment, non-expiring credit, up to 10 concurrent generations. Custom plan with per-model discounts on request.

stability-ai.role: Developer of the Stable Diffusion image models, available via API and for deployment in organizations.
stability-ai.audience: Developers and advanced creators who integrate image models via API or in their own workflows.
stability-ai.status: Active. The consumer Stable Assistant app's address now shows an enterprise solutions page with no plans or prices. No official announcement of the app closing was found; its status was not verified.
pros: Low price per image via API: Stable Diffusion 3.5 Flash costs 2.5 credits (about 0.025 USD) per image, SDXL 1.0 from 0.9 credits.
Free credits to start: a new API-platform account gets 25 free credits.
Tools beyond generation: the price list also covers upscaling, editing, control and 3D models.
cons: Consumer app not verified: the Stable Assistant address leads to an enterprise page, so it is unclear whether a monthly paid consumer interface exists today.
Free credits are one-time: the 25 credits are given at the start and the price list doesn't say they renew.
stability-ai.price: Pay-per-use API: a credit is 0.01 USD, from 0.025 USD per image on SD 3.5 Flash. 25 free credits to start.
stability-ai.free: 25 free credits for a new API account, an initial grant.
stability-ai.api: Yes. Paid API by credits (0.01 USD per credit) with Stable Image Ultra, Stable Image Core, the Stable Diffusion 3.5 family and SDXL 1.0, plus upscaling, editing and 3D models.

krea.role: Studio for creating images and video with Krea's own and other companies' models, with style control and image upscaling.
krea.audience: Designers and creators who want to try many models and control image style.
pros: Its own models with style control: Krea 2, published 12 May 2026, is Krea's first foundation model built from scratch, combining several style references with adjustable strength each. The pricing page also lists Krea 3 as new.
Free credits every day: the free plan has 100 compute units a day, renewing daily per the FAQ.
Commercial license from Basic: all paid plans, from Basic, are marked with a commercial license.
cons: Regular price unclear: at check time the pricing page ran a Black Friday sale of up to 75% off, and the struck-through prices don't match the savings shown.
No commercial license on the free plan: the Free card doesn't list one, unlike paid plans.
krea.price: Free plan with 100 compute units a day. Paid from 5 USD/month billed annually at a Black Friday sale price; regular price not verified.
krea.free: Free: 100 compute units a day, renewing daily. A commercial license is not listed on the plan card.
krea.privacy: Not verified. The Krea 2 announcement doesn't address training on user content.
krea.rights: Per the pricing page, all paid plans include a commercial license. The Free plan card doesn't list one. Full terms not read.
krea.api: Not verified: a Krea API pricing page exists (krea.ai/app/api/pricing) but wasn't read.
krea.watch: Users report credits run out fast, mainly when using the agent.

topaz-labs.role: Image-enhancement software: upscaling, sharpening and noise removal, on desktop, browser and mobile.
topaz-labs.audience: Photographers, designers and creators who need to enlarge and improve existing images.
pros: Upscaling and enhancement in a single-app subscription: you can pay only for Gigapixel (from 29 USD/month) or only Topaz for Web for images (19 USD/month, unlimited processing).
Models also in other tools: Adobe announced Topaz Labs Wonder 4 and Image HDR models at MAX 2026, and Magnific's Plus plan includes Topaz upscalers.
Desktop, browser and mobile: Topaz Studio includes Photo, Gigapixel and Video plus Topaz for Web and Topaz for Mobile.
cons: Full commercial use only in Pro: personal and standard plans cover limited commercial use for organizations with annual revenue under 1M USD. Above that you need a Pro plan.
No free plan on the pricing page: no free plan or trial shown.
Monthly credits don't roll over: per the page, monthly credits expire at month end.
topaz-labs.price: From 19 USD/month (Topaz for Web, Image). Many annual prices are discounted in a temporary promotion. No free plan on the pricing page.
plans: Topaz for Web for images and Topaz for Mobile for images, unlimited image processing.
Topaz Photo for sharpening, noise removal and enhancement.
Video, Photo, Gigapixel, Topaz for Mobile and Topaz for Web, 300 video credits/month.
All apps with Pro licenses, 600 video credits/month, full commercial use.
Topaz Photo with a Pro license.
topaz-labs.rights: Per the pricing page, personal plans and limited commercial use in Image, Video and Studio are for organizations with annual revenue under 1M USD. Pro plans add full commercial use above that threshold.
